description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for handling hashed links, including expiration logic based on time and usage, as well as timezone extraction from event data.

methods.name: extractHostTimezone
methods.description: Extracts the host timezone from event type data, prioritizing owner, then hosts, then team members, or defaults to guessed timezone.

methods.name: hasExpiryTimePassed
methods.description: Checks if a given expiration time has passed, considering optional timezone.

methods.name: isTimeBasedExpired
methods.description: Determines if a link has expired based on its expiration date and event type timezone.

methods.name: isUsageBasedExpired
methods.description: Checks if the usage count has exceeded the maximum allowed usage count.

methods.name: validateHashedLinkData
methods.description: Validates hashed link data for expiration, throws error if expired.

methods.name: isLinkExpired
methods.description: Checks if a link is expired based on time or usage.

methods.name: filterActiveLinks
methods.description: Filters out expired links from a list, returning only active links.
